cases.prompt: Mock GET /api/users for my React component tests using MSW.
expectations: Defines an MSW handler for GET /api/users returning fixture data.
Starts the server in beforeAll, resets handlers in afterEach and closes in afterAll.
Shows overriding the handler in one test to return an error.

cases.prompt: I need a WireMock stub for POST /payments returning 201 with a payment id, plus a 500 error case.
expectations: Shows a JSON mapping matching method POST and the /payments URL.
Returns status 201 with a JSON body and Content-Type header.
Shows a way to trigger the 500 case, such as a body pattern, header, priority or scenario.
